faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Boston Terrier?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 12-25 lb (5-11 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a senior Boston Terrier?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Brachycephalic obstructive airway syndrome (BOAS); Eye injuries / corneal ulcers; Patellar luxation. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Boston Terrier at this stage?
faqs.answer: At least every 30 days for a senior Boston Terrier, sooner if appetite, thirst, or mobility changes.
